Article I.


Liz Lyons (@CIASpox)

The Committee acted in bad faith by subpoenaing an Agency officer for testimony today without notifying CIA, despite having already obtained closed-door testimony from the individual previously. The witness testifying today is not appearing as a whistleblower in pursuit of the truth, but instead in response to the subpoena issued by Chairman Paul.

This proceeding amounts to nothing more than dishonest political theater masquerading as a congressional hearing.

I’m running for Attorney General to defend Texas at a time when it’s under assault from Islamists, Marxists, dark money networks, and corporate board rooms.

Texas must lead the free world. I’ll leave it all on the field using every moment God has given me to protect this state and its future. Live Free.

Video

Texas can’t afford to hand the Attorney General’s office to someone without legal experience while Islamists push to undermine our laws and Constitution.

As Attorney General, I’ll fight to uphold Texas law, defend our sovereignty, and stop any effort to impose foreign legal systems or weaken the rights and freedoms of Texans #LiveFree

100%.  I would also remind them that that FISA only got a 45 day extension and the clock has been ticking…
